mechanism: Creator content and discovery can increase Roblox users, hours, payer activity, bookings, revenue, and cash flow; shareholder benefit depends on safety and trust, creator and infrastructure costs, cohort durability, cash conversion, and dilution discipline.
catalyst: Post-age-check engagement and acquisition stabilize, payer and older-user growth remain durable, long-tail content keeps gaining share, advertising and subscriptions add monetization, creator earnings expand with sustainable platform economics, and free cash flow per diluted share grows.
invalidation: Safety or regulatory failures impair trust; age controls cause enduring acquisition or retention declines; attention fragments; content concentration rises; bookings or payer growth decouple from engagement; creator, distribution, infrastructure or moderation costs absorb revenue; deferred-revenue timing dominates cash generation; or dilution outruns per-share cash-flow growth.
